name: Roasted Asparagus & Poached Eggs with Lemon Feta Vinaigrette

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 220°C (425°F). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Peel and mince garlic. In a small bowl, prepare dressing by whisking together the minced garlic, lemon juice, olive oil, Dijon, salt, and pepper. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
juice of 1 ½ lemon
9 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tsp Dijon mustard
¾ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Measure out feta into a small bowl and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (113 g) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.primary_message: Wash asparagus and snap (or cut) off woody ends. Place in a single layer on the baking sheet; drizzle with olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 small bunches asparagus
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place in the oven and roast until tender, 10-12 minutes.
Fill a sauté pan three-quarters of the way with water and bring to a boil.
Crack 6 of the eggs into small bowls.

Once water in pan is boiling, reduce heat to medium-low. When the water is simmering, gently tip bowls, sliding eggs carefully into the water. Cook until whites are set but yolks are soft, 2 ½ to 3 minutes. Transfer eggs to paper towels. Repeat with the remaining 6 eggs.
To serve, arrange roasted asparagus on a plate and top with poached eggs. Drizzle with dressing and sprinkle with feta. Enjoy!
